production.note: US model year 2020 only. MPG Buddy (a rendering of the EPA dataset): "The EPA has rated the Bugatti Divo for one model year, the 2020 Bugatti Divo" ('Source: U.S. EPA fuel economy dataset'). fueleconomy.gov itself refuses fetches (robots). Bugatti's model page gives no production years or count.

body.note: Two-seat fixed-roof hypercar based on the Chiron; inferred from the model page.

configuration.note: Bugatti: 'Engine configuration/ Number of cylinders | W16 Motor'.

displacementL.note: 7,993 cc. Bugatti: 'Displacement | 7.993 cm³' (European decimal point: 7,993 cm³).

aspiration.note: Bugatti: 'Turbochargers | 4 Turbochargers with BUGATTI two-stage turbocharging, intercooling (water/air)'.

powerHp.note: Quote (Bugatti model page): "Power output | 1,103 kw / 1,500 hp at 6,700 rpm". Bugatti's '1,500 hp' is metric (PS): 1,103 kW x 1.34102 = 1,479.1, and 1,500 PS x 0.98632 = 1,479.5, so 1,479 hp, as for the Chiron. No separate SAE rating for the US was found, so powerStandard is DIN PS.

weightLb.note: Step 1 (manufacturer curb weight): DIN empty weight includes fluids. Quote (Bugatti model page, asked twice): "Weight (DIN empty) | 1,995 kg". 1,995 x 2.20462 = 4,398.2, rounded to 4,398 lb. Single configuration. Note: this equals Bugatti's DIN figure for the Chiron, while the earlier held entry recorded Bugatti saying the Divo is 35 kg lighter than the Chiron; Bugatti's Divo page makes no comparison, and that release was not reopened. Used as Bugatti publishes it (owner decision, 8 October 2026).

sources.publisher: MPG Buddy (U.S. EPA fuel economy dataset)
sources.title: Bugatti Divo: MPG and fuel economy by year

reviewNotes: Weight: Bugatti's Divo page gives 'Weight (DIN empty) | 1,995 kg', which equals Bugatti's DIN figure for the Chiron. The page appears to reuse a Chiron template (the gearbox text sits in a row mislabelled 'Maximum torque'), and Bugatti's launch release said the Divo is 35 kg lighter than the Chiron (that release was not reopened). Used as published on the owner decision, 8 October 2026; confirm whether about 1,960 kg is the true Divo figure.
